required_concepts: place value of numbers in the US system
acceptable_paraphrases: fifty tens, eighty twos, and five ones
critical_errors: incorrect place values (e.g. putting 'five' in the hundreds place)
misconceptions: believing that numbers in US place value only go up to three digits
thinking that every digit has the same value regardless of its position
confusing place values with arithmetic operations (e.g. addition, subtraction)
grading_notes: Students must demonstrate correct use of place value for a three-digit number.
